pages.title: Logistics: Packages
pages.text:
[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **Key points**

- [#](FFFFFF)[#]() A **Packager** on a chest packs items into addressed **Packages**.
- **Frogports** send and receive them over chain conveyors or belts.
- A **Stock Ticker** orders items from the whole network.
- Stock Links reach anywhere, but packages still need transport.

Create 6 added a **logistics** system: items are packed into **Packages**, addressed, and delivered between points. It runs on [#](2E5AAC)[belts](entry://create_basics/item_logistics)[#](), chain conveyors and frogports.

pages.title: Packager
pages.text: Attaches to a chest or machine. With redstone power it packs items; given a package it unpacks into the inventory.

pages.title: Package Frogport
pages.text: Sends and receives packages. Gives each port an address. A chain conveyor links ports together.

pages.title: Chain Conveyor
pages.text: Carries packages and relays rotation like [#](2E5AAC)[shafts](entry://create_basics/transmission)[#](). Frogports attach to it for delivery over long distances.

pages.title: Stock Link
pages.text: Connects packagers to one network. Range is unlimited, but packages still need transport.

pages.title: Stock Ticker
pages.text: Orders items from the whole network. A [#](2E5AAC)[blaze burner](entry://create_basics/heat)[#]() or seated mob in front acts as the Stock Keeper you right-click.

pages.title: Redstone Requester
pages.text: Orders a preset set on each redstone pulse.

pages.title: Factory Gauge
pages.text: Keeps stock at a target amount by requesting ingredients, down to full recipes and crafting setups.

[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **In depth.** **Add-ons in this pack**:

- Factory Logistics: network links, fluid gauges, a Bottler and jars for fluids

- Mobile Packages: Robo Bee Port to send packages to players, a portable stock ticker
